scope: Translate Help.tscn Mutation Tree + Ailments sections (full game mechanics reference).

bbcode_text = "[center]Mutation Tree[/center]

As you kill monsters, you'll increase your Mutation Tier, which allows you to allocate Mutation Points in the Mutation Tree. These are permanent upgrades to all characters -- don't worry, you can refund them any time for free, and save loadouts!


[center]Equipment[/center]

Equipment Items are powerful upgrades to your characters, providing a various array of damage and survivability upgrades, as well as mechanical changes to skills! Equipment can drop from killing monsters, with a small chance to contain a high tier locked mod.

In later game zones (>100), Items can start dropping with Affix Effectiveness quality which boosts the power of all rollable affixes (non-unique) on the item by a percentage. The maximum Affix Effectiveness for any item is deteremined by the item level. This cannot be rerolled.

Max Affix Effectiveness = max(0, (Item Level - 100))

[color=#d0dd5d]Mods which appear yellow[/color] are implicits and cannot be rerolled.

[color=#2eb62a]Mods which appear green[/color] are already at their maximum Mod Level for the gene it is on.

[color=#942ab6]Mods which appear purple[/color] are Drop Only mods, and can only be found, not crafted.



[center]Damage Types[/center]
[color=#b3b3b3]Physical Damage[/color]
[color=#a3b300]Lightning Damage[/color]
[color=#006cb3]Cold Damage[/color]
[color=#b33b00]Fire Damage[/color]
[color=#7700b3]Toxic Damage[/color]


[center]Maximum Level[/center]

The maximum character level is 150.

[center]Enemy Scaling[/center]

Enemy damage stops scaling past zone 125, but their life pool scales indefinitely.

[center]Zone Level Resistance Penalty[/center]

Players and their allies have all resistances reduced by half the zone level, rounded down.


[center]Attributes[/center]

Constitution: Grants 1 Maximum Life per Constitution
Strength: Grants 1% Increased Armor per Strength
Agility:  Grants 1% Increased Evasion per Agility
Wisdom: Grants 1% Increased Damage per 5 Wisdom
Finesse: Grants 1% Increased Cast Speed per 5 Finesse


[center] Boons [/center]

There are 3 Boon types: Precision, Swiftness, and Toughness

Precision Boons each grant 30% Increased Critical Strike Chance.

Swiftness Boons each grant 4% More Movement Speed and 4% More Cast Speed.

Toughness Boons each grant 5% Less Damage Taken, up to 90%..


[center]Triggered Skills[/center]

Skills can only be supported by a single trigger support, otherwise they become disabled. If a skill is triggered, it has an internal cooldown of 100ms, so cannot trigger more than 10 times per second.


[center]Ailment Damage & Critical Strike Interactions[/center]

Ailment damage is calculated on the crit-rolled, but unmitigated damage of a skill. Thus, critical strikes do affect ailment strength.


[center]Armor[/center]

Armor applies Less Damage taken from Hits, and it's effectiveness is dependent on your account level.
As your level increases, you need more Armor to achieve the same defensive value.

The exact formula for the mitigation percentage is as follows:

[color=#d38b1a]damage_taken_multiplier = 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))[/color]

At level 150, the cap is reached at around 225k Armor.

Armor has maximum effectiveness of 75% damage reduction.

[center]Evasion[/center]

Evasion gives a chance to evade hits, and it's effectiveness is dependent on your account level.
As your level increases, you need more Evasion to achieve the same defensive value.

The exact formula for the evade percentage is as follows:

[color=#d38b1a]evade_chance = 1.0 - 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))[/color]

At level 150, the cap is reached at around 225k Evasion.

Evasion has maximum effectiveness of 75% evade chance.


[center]Layering Defenses[/center]

It's usually a good idea to stack multiple layers of damage mitigation. For example, if you have 90% damage reduction from Armor, and 75% Fire Resistance, then incoming Fire Hit Damage will by reduced by Armor and then Fire Resistance.

For example, 100 Fire damage would reduce down as follows:
After Armor: 100 * 0.1 = 10 Fire Damage
After Fire Resistance = 10 * 0.25 = 2.5 Fire Damage

So stacking both Armor and Fire Resistance would result in 97.5% less damage taken from Fire hits. Very effective! This continues to work with damage reduction from Toughness Boons, Curses, etc.


[center]Increased vs More[/center]

For any given stat, generally speaking, [color=#d38b1a]Increased[/color] and [color=#d38b1a]Reduced[/color] act additively with each other, and [color=#d38b1a]More[/color] and [color=#d38b1a]Less[/color] work multiplicatively with each other.

For any Damaging skill, Increases and Reductions to damage types with matching tags (ie. Physical, Toxic, Hit, etc) are pooled together.

The general formula is as follows for each damage type:

[color=#d38b1a]final_damage = base_damage * max(0, (1.0 + sum(increases) - sum(reduces)) * product(mores) * product(lesses)[/color]

As an example, consider having a Gene with the following stats:
100% Increased Hit Damage
100% Increased Physical Damage
20% More Projectile Damage

If you have a skill with 10 Physical Damage, the final damage of the skill would be computed as follows:

final_damage = 10 * (1.0 + 1.00 + 1.00) * (1.2)

which gives 36 Physical Damage


[center]Unique Mods[/center]

Unique modifiers, marked with [color=#d38b1a]orange text[/color], do not stack.


[center]Damage Conversion[/center]
 
To prevent cyclic conversions, and infinite loops, Damage types can only be converted in one direction (but can skip converted types). In Mutagenic, this is as follows:

[color=#d38b1a]Physical -> Lightning -> Cold - > Fire -> Toxic.[/color]

This choice was inspired by a popular ARPG.

If a damage type has more than 100% Conversion, it will scale down proportionately to 100%.

eg. If you have 75% Physical Damage Converted to Cold Damage and 75% Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage, this will get scaled down to 50%/50%.

Converted damage will be affected by all Damage Type modifiers that apply during the conversion process.

As an example, consider having a Gene with the following stats:
25% Physical Damage Converted to Lightning Damage
100% Lightning Damage Converted to Toxic Damage
50% Increased Lightning Damage
50% Increased Toxic Damage

If you have a skill with 10 Physical Damage, the final damage after conversions would be the following:

Non Converted Damage:
7.5 Physical Damage

Converted Damage:
10 Physical Damage * (25% phys->lightning) 2.5 Lightning Damage					 ** Lightning modifiers affect this
	-> 2.5 Lightning Damage (100% lightning->toxic) -> 2.5 Toxic Damage				** Toxic modifiers affect this
		-> 2.5 Toxic Damage
				
Now that the conversions are done, we get the following:
7.5 Physical Damage (no modifiers affecting it)
2.5 Toxic Damage (Physical, Lightning, Toxic all affecting this damage amount)
	Now, using the damage formula above, we get the following final Toxic Damage:
	-> 2.5 * (1.0 + 0.50 + 0.50) = 5.0 Toxic Damage
	
This results in the final damage of this skill being (7.5 Physical Damage + 5.0 Toxic Damage).



[center]Damage Over Time[/center]

[color=#d38b1a]Damage Over Time[/color] is a special modifier which acts as a More multiplier to any damage over time, either dealt by Ailments or Skills.






"
patches.new_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]天赋树[/center]

击杀怪物会提升你的突变等级，从而让你能在天赋树中分配突变点数。这些是对所有角色都生效的永久强化——别担心，你可以随时免费退款，还能保存配置！


[center]装备[/center]

装备物品是对角色强力的升级，提供各种伤害与生存能力的提升，以及对技能机制的改变！装备可以从击杀怪物中掉落，且有小几率包含高阶锁定修饰。

在后期的区域（>100）中，物品可以掉落带有词缀效率品质的，这会按百分比提升物品上所有可重掷词缀（非独特）的强度。任何物品的最大词缀效率由物品等级决定。此属性无法重掷。

最大词缀效率 = max(0, (物品等级 - 100))

[color=#d0dd5d]黄色的修饰[/color]是固有修饰，无法重掷。

[color=#2eb62a]绿色的修饰[/color]已经达到该基因上的修饰等级上限。

[color=#942ab6]紫色的修饰[/color]是仅掉落修饰，只能找到，无法通过工艺制作。



[center]伤害类型[/center]
[color=#b3b3b3]物理伤害[/color]
[color=#a3b300]闪电伤害[/color]
[color=#006cb3]冰冷伤害[/color]
[color=#b33b00]火焰伤害[/color]
[color=#7700b3]毒性伤害[/color]


[center]最高等级[/center]

角色最高等级为 150。

[center]敌人成长[/center]

敌人伤害在区域 125 之后不再成长，但它们的生命池会无限成长。

[center]区域等级抗性惩罚[/center]

玩家及其盟友的所有抗性会降低区域等级的一半（向下取整）。


[center]属性[/center]

体质：每点体质提供 1 点最大生命值
力量：每点力量提供 1% 增加护甲
敏捷：每点敏捷提供 1% 增加闪避
智慧：每 5 点智慧提供 1% 增加伤害
灵巧：每 5 点灵巧提供 1% 增加施法速度


[center] 恩惠 [/center]

共有 3 种恩惠：精准、迅捷和坚韧

每个精准恩惠提供 30% 增加暴击率。

每个迅捷恩惠提供 4% 更多移动速度和 4% 更多施法速度。

每个坚韧恩惠提供 5% 更少承受伤害，最高 90%。


[center]触发技能[/center]

每个技能只能被一个触发辅助支撑，否则会被禁用。如果技能被触发，它会有 100ms 的内置冷却，因此每秒最多触发 10 次。


[center]异常伤害与暴击互动[/center]

异常伤害基于技能暴击判定后、但未减免的伤害计算。因此，暴击确实会影响异常强度。


[center]护甲[/center]

护甲提供更少的承受伤害，其效果取决于你的账号等级。
随着你的等级提升，需要更多护甲才能达到相同的防御效果。

减免百分比的具体公式如下：

[color=#d38b1a]damage_taken_multiplier = 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))[/color]

在 150 级时，大约 22.5 万护甲达到上限。

护甲最高提供 75% 的伤害减免。

[center]闪避[/center]

闪避提供几率闪避攻击，其效果取决于你的账号等级。
随着你的等级提升，需要更多闪避才能达到相同的防御效果。

闪避百分比的具体公式如下：

[color=#d38b1a]evade_chance = 1.0 - 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))[/color]

在 150 级时，大约 22.5 万闪避达到上限。

闪避最高提供 75% 的闪避几率。


[center]层层防御[/center]

通常建议叠加多层伤害减免。例如，如果你有 90% 的护甲伤害减免和 75% 的火焰抗性，那么受到的火焰攻击伤害会先被护甲减免，再被火焰抗性减免。

例如，100 点火焰伤害会按如下方式递减：
护甲减免后：100 * 0.1 = 10 点火焰伤害
火焰抗性后 = 10 * 0.25 = 2.5 点火焰伤害

因此，同时叠加护甲和火焰抗性会使火焰攻击的承受伤害减少 97.5%。非常有效！这同样适用于坚韧恩惠、诅咒等的伤害减免。


[center]增加 vs 更多[/center]

对于任何属性，一般来说，[color=#d38b1a]增加[/color]和[color=#d38b1a]减少[/color]彼此相加计算，而[color=#d38b1a]更多[/color]和[color=#d38b1a]更少[/color]彼此相乘计算。

对于任何伤害技能，匹配标签（如物理、毒性、命中等）的伤害类型的增加和减少会合并在一起。

每种伤害类型的通用公式如下：

[color=#d38b1a]final_damage = base_damage * max(0, (1.0 + sum(increases) - sum(reduces)) * product(mores) * product(lesses)[/color]

例如，考虑一个拥有以下属性的基因：
100% 增加命中伤害
100% 增加物理伤害
20% 更多投射物伤害

如果你有一个 10 点物理伤害的技能，该技能的最终伤害计算如下：

final_damage = 10 * (1.0 + 1.00 + 1.00) * (1.2)

结果为 36 点物理伤害


[center]独特修饰[/center]

标有[color=#d38b1a]橙色文字[/color]的独特修饰不会叠加。


[center]伤害转化[/center]
 
为防止循环转化和无限循环，伤害类型只能向一个方向转化（但可以跳过已转化的类型）。在 Mutagenic 中，转化顺序如下：

[color=#d38b1a]Physical -> Lightning -> Cold - > Fire -> Toxic.[/color]

这个设计灵感来自一款流行的 ARPG。

如果一种伤害类型的转化超过 100%，会按比例缩减到 100%。

例如：如果你有 75% 物理伤害转化为冰冷伤害和 75% 物理伤害转化为火焰伤害，这会被缩减为 50%/50%。

转化的伤害会受到转化过程中适用的所有伤害类型修饰的影响。

例如，考虑一个拥有以下属性的基因：
25% 物理伤害转化为闪电伤害
100% 闪电伤害转化为毒性伤害
50% 增加闪电伤害
50% 增加毒性伤害

如果你有一个 10 点物理伤害的技能，转化后的最终伤害如下：

未转化的伤害：
7.5 点物理伤害

转化的伤害：
10 点物理伤害 * (25% 物理->闪电) 2.5 点闪电伤害					 ** 闪电修饰会影响此伤害
	-> 2.5 点闪电伤害 (100% 闪电->毒性) -> 2.5 点毒性伤害				** 毒性修饰会影响此伤害
		-> 2.5 点毒性伤害
				
转化完成后，我们得到如下结果：
7.5 点物理伤害（不受任何修饰影响）
2.5 点毒性伤害（物理、闪电、毒性都会影响此伤害量）
	现在，使用上面的伤害公式，我们得到以下最终毒性伤害：
	-> 2.5 * (1.0 + 0.50 + 0.50) = 5.0 点毒性伤害
	
因此该技能的最终伤害为（7.5 点物理伤害 + 5.0 点毒性伤害）。



[center]持续伤害[/center]

[color=#d38b1a]持续伤害[/color]是一种特殊修饰，作为任何持续伤害（由异常或技能造成）的更多倍率。



"

护甲提供更少的承受伤害，其效果取决于你的账号等级。
随着你的等级提升，需要更多护甲才能达到相同的防御效果。

减免百分比的具体公式如下：

damage_taken_multiplier = 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))

在 150 级时，大约 22.5 万护甲达到上限。

护甲最高提供 75% 的伤害减免。

闪避

闪避提供几率闪避攻击，其效果取决于你的账号等级。
随着你的等级提升，需要更多闪避才能达到相同的防御效果。

闪避百分比的具体公式如下：

evade_chance = 1.0 - 1.0 / min(4.0, 2.0 ^ (armor / (level ^ 2)))

在 150 级时，大约 22.5 万闪避达到上限。

闪避最高提供 75% 的闪避几率。


层层防御

通常建议叠加多层伤害减免。例如，如果你有 90% 的护甲伤害减免和 75% 的火焰抗性，那么受到的火焰攻击伤害会先被护甲减免，再被火焰抗性减免。

例如，100 点火焰伤害会按如下方式递减：
护甲减免后：100 * 0.1 = 10 点火焰伤害
火焰抗性后 = 10 * 0.25 = 2.5 点火焰伤害

因此，同时叠加护甲和火焰抗性会使火焰攻击的承受伤害减少 97.5%。非常有效！这同样适用于坚韧恩惠、诅咒等的伤害减免。


增加 vs 更多

对于任何属性，一般来说，增加和减少彼此相加计算，而更多和更少彼此相乘计算。

对于任何伤害技能，匹配标签（如物理、毒性、命中等）的伤害类型的增加和减少会合并在一起。

每种伤害类型的通用公式如下：

final_damage = base_damage * max(0, (1.0 + sum(increases) - sum(reduces)) * product(mores) * product(lesses)

例如，考虑一个拥有以下属性的基因：
100% 增加命中伤害
100% 增加物理伤害
20% 更多投射物伤害

如果你有一个 10 点物理伤害的技能，该技能的最终伤害计算如下：

final_damage = 10 * (1.0 + 1.00 + 1.00) * (1.2)

结果为 36 点物理伤害


独特修饰

标有橙色文字的独特修饰不会叠加。


伤害转化
 
为防止循环转化和无限循环，伤害类型只能向一个方向转化（但可以跳过已转化的类型）。在 Mutagenic 中，转化顺序如下：

Physical -> Lightning -> Cold - > Fire -> Toxic.

这个设计灵感来自一款流行的 ARPG。

如果一种伤害类型的转化超过 100%，会按比例缩减到 100%。

例如：如果你有 75% 物理伤害转化为冰冷伤害和 75% 物理伤害转化为火焰伤害，这会被缩减为 50%/50%。

转化的伤害会受到转化过程中适用的所有伤害类型修饰的影响。

例如，考虑一个拥有以下属性的基因：
25% 物理伤害转化为闪电伤害
100% 闪电伤害转化为毒性伤害
50% 增加闪电伤害
50% 增加毒性伤害

如果你有一个 10 点物理伤害的技能，转化后的最终伤害如下：

未转化的伤害：
7.5 点物理伤害

转化的伤害：
10 点物理伤害 * (25% 物理->闪电) 2.5 点闪电伤害					 ** 闪电修饰会影响此伤害
	-> 2.5 点闪电伤害 (100% 闪电->毒性) -> 2.5 点毒性伤害				** 毒性修饰会影响此伤害
		-> 2.5 点毒性伤害
				
转化完成后，我们得到如下结果：
7.5 点物理伤害（不受任何修饰影响）
2.5 点毒性伤害（物理、闪电、毒性都会影响此伤害量）
	现在，使用上面的伤害公式，我们得到以下最终毒性伤害：
	-> 2.5 * (1.0 + 0.50 + 0.50) = 5.0 点毒性伤害
	
因此该技能的最终伤害为（7.5 点物理伤害 + 5.0 点毒性伤害）。



持续伤害

持续伤害是一种特殊修饰，作为任何持续伤害（由异常或技能造成）的更多倍率。



"

patches.old_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]Ailments[/center]

There are 2 ailment types for each damage type. The first is the ordinary Ailment, and the second is the Enhanced Ailment. For each Ailment, there is a corresponding Ailment Chance stat which is used to calculate the chances of inflicting the Ailment. If the Ailment is successfully inflicted, then your Enhanced Ailment Chance is used to possibly inflict the enhanced version of the Ailment as well!

Note: [color=#d38b1a]Penetration does not affect ailments, but it does affect Damage over Time skills.[/color]

[center][color=#b3b3b3]Physical Ailments[/color][/center]

[color=#b3b3b3][i]Bleed:[/i][/color] Bleeds deal physical damage over time. The base Bleed damage is equal to 5% of the physical hit amount, and have a base duration of 4 seconds.

[color=#b3b3b3][i]Rupture:[/i][/color] Ruptures are Bleeds which deal 100% More Damage, but have 50% Less Duration.

[center][color=#a3b300]Lightning Ailments[/color][/center]

[color=#a3b300][i]Jolt:[/i][/color] Jolted enemies take increased damaged. The effect of the Jolt scales with how much damage the hit inflicted, as a percentage of the targets maximum life. Base Jolt duration is 4 seconds.

[color=#a3b300][i]Electrocution:[/i][/color] Electrocuted enemies have reduced resistances. The effect of the Electrocution scales with how much damage the hit inflicted, as a percentage of the targets maximum life. Base Electrocution duration is 4 seconds.

[center][color=#006cb3]Cold Ailments[/color][/center]

[color=#006cb3][i]Chill:[/i][/color] Chilled enemies move and attack slower. The effect of the Chill scales with how much damage the hit inflicted, as a percentage of the targets maximum life. Base Chill duration is 4 seconds.

[color=#006cb3][i]Freeze:[/i][/color] Frozen enemies cannot move or attack. Base Freeze duration is 0.25 seconds.

[center][color=#b33b00]Fire Ailments[/color][/center]

[color=#b33b00][i]Burn:[/i][/color] Burn deals fire damage over time. The base Burn damage is equal to 100% of the fire hit amount, and have a base duration of 4 seconds. Burns cannot stack.

[color=#b33b00][i]Char:[/i][/color] Charred enemies deal Less Damage. The effect of the Char scales with how much damage the hit inflicted, as a percentage of the targets maximum life. Base Char duration is 2 seconds.

[center][color=#7700b3]Toxic Ailments[/color][/center]

[color=#7700b3][i]Poison:[/i][/color] Poison deals Toxic damage over time. The base Poison damage is equal to 5% of the Toxic hit amount, and have a base duration of 4 seconds.

[color=#7700b3][i]Infection:[/i][/color] Infections are Poisons which spread to a nearby enemy when their current host dies. Only the strongest infection will spread, but this can be increased by Infection Spread Count.

[center]Vulnerable[/center]
[color=#d38b1a]Vulnerable[/color] causes the affected enemy/player to take 25% More Damage.

[center]Exposed[/center]
[color=#d38b1a]Exposed[/color] causes the affected enemy/player have -10% to All Resistances.



[center]Ailment Ramping[/center]

Certain ailments which apply damage over time which stack (Bleed, Rupture, Poison, Infection), apply their damage in a unique way.

When one of these ailments is applied, one of the following happens:

1. If there is no ailment of the given type on the enemy, apply the ailment as normal.
2. If there is an existing ailment of the given type on the enemy, ramp up the damage of the existing one instead.

When an ailment gets ramped up, it takes the entire damage of the incoming ailment, and spreads it over the existing ailments duration.

For example:

1. Bleed A gets applied to do 5 dps, for 5 seconds. The total damage this Bleed will apply is 5 * 5 = 25 damage units.
2. Bleed B gets applied after 2.5 seconds, doing the same 5 dps for 5 seconds.
3. Since Bleed A is still active, Bleed B will instead ramp up Bleed A.
4. Bleed B total damage is 5 * 5 = 25 damage units, and Bleed A has 2.5 seconds remaining. This means Bleed B will \"ramp up\" Bleed A by 10 dps, since the remaining duration is 2.5 seconds, and it has to apply 25 more damage units.

Once Bleed A expires, the ramp starts over once the next ailment is applied."
patches.new_text:
bbcode_text = "[center]异常状态[/center]

每种伤害类型有 2 种异常状态。第一种是普通异常，第二种是强化异常。每种异常都有对应的异常几率属性，用于计算施加该异常的几率。如果异常成功施加，那么你的强化异常几率会用来决定是否施加强化版本！

注意：[color=#d38b1a]穿透不影响异常状态，但它会影响持续伤害技能。[/color]

[center][color=#b3b3b3]物理异常[/color][/center]

[color=#b3b3b3][i]流血：[/i][/color]流血造成物理持续伤害。基础流血伤害等于物理命中伤害的 5%，基础持续时间为 4 秒。

[color=#b3b3b3][i]撕裂：[/i][/color]撕裂是造成 100% 更多伤害的流血，但持续时间减少 50%。

[center][color=#a3b300]闪电异常[/color][/center]

[color=#a3b300][i]电击：[/i][/color]被电击的敌人受到更多伤害。电击效果随命中造成的伤害占目标最大生命的百分比而增强。基础电击持续时间为 4 秒。

[color=#a3b300][i]触电：[/i][/color]被触电的敌人抗性降低。触电效果随命中造成的伤害占目标最大生命的百分比而增强。基础触电持续时间为 4 秒。

[center][color=#006cb3]冰冷异常[/color][/center]

[color=#006cb3][i]寒冷：[/i][/color]被寒冷的敌人移动和攻击更慢。寒冷效果随命中造成的伤害占目标最大生命的百分比而增强。基础寒冷持续时间为 4 秒。

[color=#006cb3][i]冻结：[/i][/color]被冻结的敌人无法移动或攻击。基础冻结持续时间为 0.25 秒。

[center][color=#b33b00]火焰异常[/color][/center]

[color=#b33b00][i]燃烧：[/i][/color]燃烧造成火焰持续伤害。基础燃烧伤害等于火焰命中伤害的 100%，基础持续时间为 4 秒。燃烧无法叠加。

[color=#b33b00][i]焦灼：[/i][/color]被焦灼的敌人造成更少伤害。焦灼效果随命中造成的伤害占目标最大生命的百分比而增强。基础焦灼持续时间为 2 秒。

[center][color=#7700b3]毒性异常[/color][/center]

[color=#7700b3][i]中毒：[/i][/color]中毒造成毒性持续伤害。基础中毒伤害等于毒性命中伤害的 5%，基础持续时间为 4 秒。

[color=#7700b3][i]感染：[/i][/color]感染是当当前宿主死亡时会传播到附近敌人的中毒。只有最强的感染会传播，但感染传播次数可以提升。

[center]脆弱[/center]
[color=#d38b1a]脆弱[/color]使受影响的敌人/玩家受到 25% 更多伤害。

[center]暴露[/center]
[color=#d38b1a]暴露[/color]使受影响的敌人/玩家所有抗性降低 10%。



[center]异常堆积[/center]

某些施加持续伤害且可叠加的异常（流血、撕裂、中毒、感染），会以独特方式施加伤害。

当施加这些异常之一时，会发生以下情况之一：

1. 如果敌人身上没有该类型的异常，则正常施加异常。
2. 如果敌人身上已有该类型的异常，则改为强化已有异常的伤害。

当异常被强化时，它会吸收新异常的整个伤害，并将其分摊到已有异常的剩余持续时间上。

例如：

1. 流血 A 被施加，每秒造成 5 点伤害，持续 5 秒。该流血的伤害总量为 5 * 5 = 25 点伤害。
2. 2.5 秒后施加流血 B，同样每秒造成 5 点伤害，持续 5 秒。
3. 由于流血 A 仍然生效，流血 B 会改为强化流血 A。
4. 流血 B 的总伤害是 5 * 5 = 25 点伤害，而流血 A 还剩 2.5 秒。这意味着流血 B 会以 10 点每秒的速度强化流血 A，因为剩余持续时间是 2.5 秒，且它需要施加 25 点额外伤害。

一旦流血 A 结束，下一次施加异常时堆积重新开始。"
